scope: Read-only algorithm analysis. Local diagnostic replays; no network, controller, solver or tolerance change. Native calls are the existing Clarabel MEX.
method: Seven recorded-input fixtures, five discarded warmups and eleven unprofiled repetitions each in a fresh process that never enables profile; separate function profiles and seven coarse-probe repetitions per fixture with command equality.
profilerLimitation: Initial profiling interleaved with wall timing changed later JIT timing; those timing samples are retained but excluded. Fine profiler greatly perturbs exist/kernel dispatch. Coarse probes also add overhead: crossing median 149.356 ms versus uninstrumented 120.923 ms. Never sum nested inclusive timings.
finding: Fresh crossing admission uses two support families, four restoration and three hard solves (eight native calls), nine normal proposals and five geometry builds. Four inner normal calculations are overwritten by already supplied proposals. Independent hard verification is small; finite prediction is performed only once.
